title: Bohrin results row
description: One line of a JSON Lines results file: one model's score on one task, for one sample. Other fields are allowed and ignored, so an existing results file can be read as it is.

score.description: The reward the grader gave, or null when the sample errored and got no score.

max_score.description: Full marks for this task. Defaults to 1.

cluster.description: Tasks that share a source (a repository, a passage) share a cluster.

sample.description: Which repeat of the task this is, when a task is scored more than once.
